betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The controller takes steam and lubricant; ore enters and leaves at the logistics module. Form all modules, use a Hub Terminal on the controller, verify Topology, then assign steps under Links. Each chain accepts up to 16 steps.

Start with just the crushing step. Feed a few suitable ores to logistics, leave an outlet for crushed ore, enable the module and supply steam and lubricant. Allow 30 seconds for full heat. Add washing only after the first output arrives. A bad chain prevents starting; losing steam or lubricant mid-batch destroys the work in progress.

Once output is steady, choose speed or parallel for a backlog, or product boosters for recovery. Change one setting at a time and compare throughput, steam and lubricant. Logistics draws lubricant too.
